57. MARRIAGE ASSISTANCE TO NORMAL PERSONS MARRYING 
ORTHOPAEDICALLY  
DIFFERENTLY  ABLED  PERSONS   
 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme 
Marriage assistance to normal persons marrying 
orthopaedically 
differently 
abled 
persons; 
marriage assistance is given to normal person 
who marries a orthopaedically person. Total 
assistance given is Rs.25,000/-.  Rs.12,500/- is 
given in the form of National Savings Certificate 
and Rs.12,500/- as Cheque or Demand Draft 
towards marriage expenses along with 
a 
certificate of appreciation and   8 gram gold 
coin 
for 
making 
Tirumangalyam 
from 
23.05.2016. 
 
If either the Differently abled person or a 
normal person is holding degree or diploma, the 
marriage assistance is Rs.50,000/-.  
 
Rs.25,000/-   in   the   form   of   National 
Saving Certificate  and  Rs.25,000/- as cheque or 
Demand Draft with  8 gram gold coin for 
making Tirumangalyam. 
2. 
Eligibility Criteria 
Normal   person should marry an orthopaedically 
differently abled person. The age of the couple
(both) should be above 18 years. 
3. 
Whether   the prescribed 
application form is available 
Yes. Prescribed formats are available with 
District Differently Abled Welfare Office. 
4. 
Certificates to be furnished 
National identity card for differently abled and 
proof for marriage and age certificate. 
5. 
Officer to whom the application 
is to be submitted 
District Differently Abled Welfare Officer 
6. 
Grievances if any to be addressed 
to 
Assistant Director (DAW), 
O/o. The Commissionerate  for Welfare of the 
Differently abled, 
No.5, Kamarajar salai, 
Chennai – 600 005.  
Ph: 044-28444940
